transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because my eating has gotten really out of hand. A lot of evenings I’ll buy a family-size takeout order, then pick up chips or bakery stuff too, and I end up eating most of it myself before I even really notice how much I’ve gone through.
How do you feel after you've eaten a large amount of food in a short time?

Afterward I feel really physically awful. I keep eating past the point where I should stop, until my stomach feels tight and painful. Then I just sit very still on the couch because even getting up or walking upstairs feels uncomfortable.
Do you feel guilty after eating such a large amount of food?
I don’t know... I mean, I don’t really have a clear answer for that. I mostly notice how bad I feel physically afterward. The guilt part—I’m not sure how to describe it.
Do you feel like you're able to stop eating or control how much you're eating during these episodes?

No, not really. Once I start, it feels like some switch flips. I can be thinking, “Taylor, stop, put it away,” but I just keep opening containers and eating anyway, like I’m not really the one in control.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time happen?
When I look back at my journal, there’s hardly been a week in the last several months where it didn’t happen at least once. Most weeks, honestly, it’s several nights.
Do you ever feel guilty or ashamed after these episodes of eating a large amount of food?

I’m honestly not sure I’d call it guilt or shame. I know I feel upset with myself sometimes, but it’s more like… I don’t want to think about it afterward. It’s hard for me to separate what I’m feeling exactly.
Do you typically try to hide your eating or eat alone during these episodes?

Yes. I usually wait until my husband is asleep, or if there are contractors at the house, I wait until they’re gone. I don’t want anyone seeing how much I can eat, especially after I’ve acted so in control all day at work. I’d be mortified.
Do you worry about gaining weight after one of these eating episodes?

I don’t really know. I mean, I’m aware of it, but after it happens I mostly just feel kind of shut down and try not to think about it. I haven’t really noticed if I’m specifically worrying about weight right then.
Do you ever try to make up for eating a large amount of food by doing something to counteract it, like exercising or vomiting?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think of myself as doing something specific to make up for it, but I haven’t paid close attention to that pattern. I usually just kind of move on and try not to dwell on it.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food?
I don’t think so. I’m not aware of making myself vomit after those times. I usually just feel bad and try to get past it.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been tracking it closely, and I can’t say I’ve noticed a major change either way.
Do you regularly eat large amounts of food in a short time without trying to make up for it afterwards?

Yes. That’s actually why I came in. I keep having evenings where I’ll buy a family-size takeout order, then add chips or something from the bakery, and I end up eating most of it myself before I even really register how much is gone. I’m not doing anything afterward to make up for it.
Do you usually eat this way when you're stressed or upset?
I’m not really sure. I mean, sometimes I notice it’s after a hard day, but I haven’t clearly tracked whether it’s always when I’m stressed or upset.
Do you think your eating episodes are usually triggered by feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?

I don’t know if I can say “usually.” Sometimes it does seem to happen after I’m tense or upset, but other times I can’t really point to a clear trigger. I haven’t kept track closely enough to be sure.
Do you feel stressed or anxious right before you start eating a large amount of food?
I’m not sure. Sometimes I do feel wound up beforehand, but I haven’t really noticed a clear pattern right before it starts. It can just sort of happen before I’ve thought it through.
Do you feel stressed or anxious right before you start eating a large amount of food?
I can’t really say for sure. Sometimes I realize I was stressed after the fact, but right before it starts, I don’t always notice what I’m feeling. It just kind of happens.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed about your eating after these episodes have passed?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I know I don’t feel good about it afterward, but I haven’t really sorted out whether that’s guilt or shame exactly. It’s just… not a good feeling.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food have passed?
I don’t know if I’d call it guilt exactly. I just feel bad afterward and kind of upset with myself, but I’m not sure how to separate that from guilt.
Do you feel guilty after eating a large amount of food?
I’m not sure I can say it’s guilt, exactly. I do feel bad afterward, and I don’t like that it happened, but I have a hard time putting a name to it.
